prompt:
A Binary Search Tree (BST) is constructed by sequentially inserting the following keys into an initially empty tree:
`[120, 70, 170, 45, 95, 145, 195]`

What is the exact **Postorder** traversal sequence of this tree?
explanation: Postorder traversal visits Left Subtree -> Right Subtree -> Root. Root 120 is processed last after all its children: [45, 95, 70, 145, 195, 170, 120].
